title: Case 042: Confirmed Client Time
initial_request: I can attend the proposed inspection on 12 August 2025 at 10:30 am and can provide access to 142 Ash Walk, Brackenford, ZZ5 6ZZ. Please let the insurer know that this time works for me.
overview: Mark confirmed the proposed 12 August 2025 at 10:30 am inspection and access arrangements with Naomi at Merehaven Brokers. Naomi noted that the insurer still needed to be informed, sent the time to Fenwick Vale Insurance, and received confirmation that it had been recorded on the insurer’s side. She relayed that confirmation to Mark, who acknowledged it. Naomi also sent the agreed appointment to the inspection organiser for visit coordination.

next_action.summary: At escalation, send Mark's confirmed 12 August 2025, 10:30 am inspection slot to Fenwick Vale Insurance for confirmation; then pass the agreed appointment to the organiser.

outcome: The 12 August 2025, 10:30 am inspection was confirmed by Mark and Fenwick Vale Insurance and communicated to the organiser.
